decision_rules.recurrence: Complete records and qualified uncertainty exist. Streams 0/1 select the smallest-mean-W consecutive triple centered at 3000..19000 (earliest tie); streams 2/3 re-measure early, basin and late W, and each confirmation stream independently must show early W exceeds basin W by >=2x and >=0.01 Ha, with at least two of 40000/45000/50000 exceeding it by both margins with simultaneous confidence bounds. At least 2 of 3 lineages pass. If two lineages pass and the third is incomplete, the study-level label is unresolved; report recurrence in the two complete lineages only. Tail exceedance safeguards must not contradict the W result, evaluated over the TAIL thresholds only (0.5 Ha, 1 Ha, and the pilot-frozen hydrogen-equivalent threshold in measurement.hydrogen_equivalent_tail_threshold); the tail-threshold safeguard pools streams 2 and 3, n=8192 walkers: a contradiction is (i) W meets the rise rule while none of the three tail thresholds shows an increase of at least its own margin in decision_rules.parameters.exceedance_margins_hartree, where an 'increase of at least its margin' means the simultaneous LOWER confidence bound of the increase reaches the margin, or (ii) W fails the rise rule, or the bounded-null band excludes it, while some fixed exceedance threshold shows an increase of at least its own margin. A bulk-threshold (0.01/0.05/0.1 Ha) decrease that accompanies a W rise is expected, as He-v1's own 25k-to-50k contrast shows, and is not a contradiction; a bulk-threshold exceedance that fails to confirm a W rise is reported as a qualification, never as a contradiction. Directional wording and evidence: operator-review-contract-proposals-20261107 items 1-2 on fffc313a, decided in primary-measure-and-margins-decision-20261107 on 8a67671f from analysis primary-measure-and-margins-analysis-20261107 (FASRC Cannon job 58568904); the tail-threshold restriction and the simultaneous-lower-bound reading are round-1 pre-review findings F4/F5, accepted 2026-11-07.
decision_rules.bounded_null: All 3 lineages are complete and pass instrument/sampling gates; simultaneous inference over every predeclared basin, checkpoint, threshold, and window search excludes the W decrease/rise rule. For every reference checkpoint k in bounded_null_reference_updates (the 21 evaluated checkpoints at or below 20,000 updates), the simultaneous band excludes W at bounded_null_late_count or more late checkpoints reaching max(2 W(k), W(k) + 0.01 Ha). Fixed-threshold exceedance bands use all four streams pooled (n=16384 walkers) and the pilot gate; for every reference checkpoint k in bounded_null_reference_updates (the same 21 evaluated checkpoints at or below 20,000 updates) and every late checkpoint, they also exclude an absolute increase from k to that late checkpoint, at every threshold including the pilot-frozen hydrogen-equivalent threshold, of at least that threshold's own margin in decision_rules.parameters.exceedance_margins_hartree (0.002 Ha at the tail thresholds 0.5, 1 Ha and the pilot-frozen hydrogen-equivalent threshold; 0.01 Ha at the bulk thresholds 0.01, 0.05 and 0.1 Ha, where the pilot gate's half-width <= half-margin requirement is otherwise unreachable), where an 'increase of at least its margin' means the simultaneous LOWER confidence bound of the increase reaches the margin. A flat MAD or nonsignificance alone is not equivalence.
decision_rules.unresolved: Any required record, identity, instrument, dependence/uncertainty qualification, tail safeguard, operator decision, or horizon is absent or inconclusive; a partial lineage result, conflicting streams, unsupported margins, or a tail-only change outside the declared instrument is unresolved.

lane_proposals.proposal: Use the historical He training basin only as context: 5k-block median of within-batch variance on a changing model, about 0.00173 Ha^2; s10=26570 and s90=44982 are definition-dependent onset summaries whose definition is only in the unopened Netscratch report, not basin-departure points. Use W, the 99.9th percentile of the absolute deviation from the median, as the primary statistic for H, with fixed exceedance probabilities as safeguards (see decision_rules for the directional-contradiction rule and decision_rules.parameters.exceedance_margins_hartree for the per-threshold margins).
lane_proposals.rationale: W detects rare-event frequency defects that MAD can hide; no fresh He basin checkpoint exists for a common-estimand threshold. Evidence (primary-measure-and-margins-analysis-20261107, Cannon job 58568904): He-v1's own 25k-to-50k fresh-evaluation contrast is a 22-25x W rise, detected identically by W and by the tail exceedance thresholds (0.5, 1 Ha), while the bulk exceedance thresholds (0.01, 0.05, 0.1 Ha) FALL at the same transition -- an exceedance-primary rule on the bulk thresholds would have called He-v1's broken checkpoint an improvement. For an He-v1-sized effect the choice of primary statistic does not change the outcome; for moderate tail-onset versus uniform-broadening effects it does, which is why the primary stays a ratio statistic (W) rather than a threshold in hartree.
alternatives: make exceedance probability the primary axis instead of percentile W

lane_proposals.decided_by: operator-review-contract-proposals-20261107 items 3 and 5 on fffc313a, quoted 'whatever He-v1 did we do in Hydrogen experiment' (item 3, correcting an earlier 'trainable' answer) and 'whatever He-v1 did' (item 5)
lane_proposals.proposal: Match He-v1 exactly, adapted only where the one-electron system forces a deviation. Primary source: the He-v1 resolved config of the executed run train-seed0000 itself (/Users/yizhonghu/he-v1-independent-report-20260823/receipts/resolved_config.yaml, sha256 b9234c469ceadb36291833a2f8ef8a02f29feeba73cdd330949eebbd90d2e8c1, listed in BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json); it agrees with experiments/atomistic/he-v1/configs/train.yaml at the executed He-v1 training source commit 418accf153368aab45586dc2a2cc97c18472691c (REPORT.md line 5 names this as the commit of record for train-seed0000/Cannon job 40907434) for the model, optimizer and sampler blocks, and records an executed horizon of 50,000 updates, which differs from the 300,000 in train.yaml and from the production_grid.yaml plan. As resolved there: one TPENLayer, Embedding max_order=2/out_channels=32/hidden_channels=128/num_hidden_layers=1/include_spins=true (lines 110-117), EquivariantMixing and PathAggregation both max_order=2/max_virtual_order=2/channels=32/initial_weight=0.5/implementation=vectorized/SiLU (lines 118-135), ResidualUpdater (line 137), training runtime dtype=float64; post-readout factors are ElectronElectronCusp(trainable_range=true) plus ElectronNucleusCusp with CurvatureElectronNucleusCuspLaw(curvature_coefficient=0.01, curvature_range=1.0, trainable=true) (lines 188-197); PfaffianReadout(channels=32, trainable=true) (lines 198-227); optimizer torch.optim.Adam(lr=0.005) (lines 277-280); training sampler MetropolisSampler(n_walkers=4096, burn_in=100, n_steps=10, proposal_scale=0.5) (lines 249-260): burn-in 100, 10 Metropolis steps per update, proposal scale 0.5 bohr. The full model, optimizer, sampler and runtime blocks of the resolved config govern, apart from the one-electron-forced deviations recorded below; the enumeration above is illustrative, not exhaustive. Nuclear curvature law: c (curvature_coefficient) = 0.01, d (curvature_range) = 1.0, both trainable -- this already matches the contract's normalizability_gate notation (outer slope -1 + c/d, exact_hydrogen_answer c=0) and required no numeric change. One-electron-forced deviations from He-v1, recorded because H has one electron where He has two: (1) ElectronElectronCusp is omitted from the H-v2 model configuration: no electron pair exists to carry same-spin or opposite-spin range gradient, so the one-electron system forces its omission (it is not retained for parsed-config agreement; its channel would be structurally inert if present, not frozen by training as He's same-spin channel is for a singlet); (2) spin configuration is n_up=1, n_down=0 (He-v1: n_up=1, n_down=1); (3) nuclear_charge is 1 (He-v1: 2), per study.nuclear_charge; (4) the PfaffianReadout's odd-electron border is retained as a readout device rather than a second electron, as already documented in README.md.
lane_proposals.rationale: A concrete model/optimizer/sampler proposal makes the pipeline and science plan reviewable without silently choosing unreviewed hyperparameters; c=0 is the exact hydrogen answer and c/d drift is a reportable normalizability signal. Matching He-v1 exactly (rather than re-deriving hyperparameters) is now an operator decision, not a lane proposal, so comparability between the He-v1 and H-v2 wavefunction families is by construction wherever the one-electron system does not force a difference.
alternatives: a revised architecture or optimizer with changed recurrence and resource implications stated

pilot.length_rationale: runs through 20,000 updates, within the 16 GPU-hour ceiling, so the pilot's own basin search covers the same centers (decision_rules.parameters.basin_center_updates, 3000..19000) that the science recurrence rule searches; the 4,000-update hard minimum remains so at least one basin-window triple exists even if the ceiling stops the pilot early, in which case the shortfall against the 20,000-update target is reported
pilot.evaluation: fresh-evaluates the contract's evaluated checkpoints (measurement.evaluated_checkpoints.updates) up to the updates actually reached, at most 20,000, at the contract shape (measurement.fresh_evaluation); seeded from non_science_seed_namespaces.capacity_pilot.evaluation (evaluation_formula)
pilot.freeze_basin_selection: the freeze uses the pilot's own smallest-mean-W consecutive triple over the centers it reached, chosen by the recurrence rule's selection (decision_rules.parameters.basin_center_updates); this is the same search the science recurrence rule performs, not necessarily the earliest triple. Decided 2026-11-07, round-3 pre-review finding H3, accepted 2026-11-07.

gpu_hour_ceiling.separate_from: the 96 GPU-hour science ceiling (lane_proposals science venue, item 7); does not count against it

fresh_evaluation.formula: 3 lineages x 27 evaluated checkpoints x 4 streams x 4096 walkers x 256 draws

raw_training_batches.formula: 3 lineages x 1001 captured batches (every_n_steps=50, iteration step 0 through 50000 inclusive) x 4096 walkers
raw_training_batches.partition_note: 20 batches per 1000-step partition gives 50 full partitions plus one single-batch partition (step 50000) per lineage; 3 lineages x 51 partitions = 153 data objects, not the 150 the storage proposal costed

storage_figures.compression_ratio: unmeasured; a pilot block must measure it before a Holystore budget promises it

tail_characterization.decided_by: lane scientific call responding to operator-decisions-560-logging-20261106c: "only a few percentile values may not be enough was my point about logging"

science_measurement.primary_evidence: the full positive and negative survival and exceedance curves computed from the retained raw rows, on the same level grid as sampler_tail_qualification down to its supported depth
science_measurement.never_substitutes: no reported percentile, W, variance, MAD, IQR, or fitted tail index replaces the raw rows

sampler_tail_qualification.layer: 028867dc (H-v2: qualify the sampler over full radial and local-energy survival curves)

alpha_1_2.description: imperfect state alpha=1.2 sampled from its own |psi|^2
alpha_1_2.tail_origin: the large positive local-energy tail comes from the inner radial tail (small r), not the outer radial tail

sampler_tail_qualification.superseded_stub: the prior stub check compared the CDF only up to r=3 (about the 94th percentile of the outer radius) and never examined the inner tail that drives W

support_rule.note: deeper levels are reported, never gated

band.centering: per-stream sample median of E_L, as in measurement.fresh_evaluation.estimator
band.se_method: whole-walker bootstrap standard error of log(S_hat), at least 2000 resamples; the median is recomputed inside every whole-walker resample
band.exact_value_centering_note: S_exact at the fixed thresholds is the oracle value centred on the exact median -0.540498, not the per-stream sample median
band.zero_count_rule: a zero count at a gated level fails
band.k_definition: the number of gated comparisons implied by radial_levels x radial_sides x 2 alphas, plus alpha_1_2_only.fixed_exceedance_thresholds_hartree, plus alpha_1_2_only.exceedance_levels, multiplied by shape_and_seeds.fresh_evaluation_sampler.streams
band.pass_rule: qualification passes only if max(|z|) over every gated comparison in both streams is at most c
